title: Career roadmap · Web3 Developer
summary: Build strong foundations in programming, blockchain architecture, cryptography, smart contracts, Solidity, Web3 applications, wallets, APIs, testing, and decentralized application security to enter Web3 development.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a standard 3-year BCA. A 4-year honours route can use the additional year for advanced smart-contract security, protocol development, cryptography, distributed systems, token economics, and blockchain research.

about.label: Course alignment
about.text: Web3 Developer is directly aligned with BCA - Blockchain / Web3.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build programming, blockchain, Solidity, JavaScript/TypeScript, wallet and smart-contract fundamentals; target Web3 Intern / Blockchain Developer Intern / Junior Web3 Developer roles.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Develop expertise in smart contracts, dApp architecture, blockchain security, DeFi, tokenisation or Web3 infrastructure.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward Senior Web3 Developer, Smart Contract Engineer, Protocol Engineer or Blockchain Security Engineer.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine blockchain with AI, zero-knowledge proofs, privacy, distributed systems, identity, tokenised assets and emerging decentralised infrastructure.

rows.text: Explain blocks, transactions, consensus, wallets and gas
Connect a frontend to a smart contract
Audit your own contracts and document vulnerabilities
Build a controlled testnet DeFi/token project
Deploy a tested dApp with documented architecture

blocks.text: 4-year honours variant

Use Year 4 for advanced Solidity, protocol architecture, zero-knowledge systems, cryptography, smart-contract auditing, distributed systems, Layer-2 technologies and blockchain research. A strong final project could be a tested dApp with a smart-contract security assessment and reproducible deployment process.
Specialisation lanes

rows.text: Solidity security, testing, auditing, threat modelling

blocks.text: Do not tie your career to one blockchain or token ecosystem. Build durable expertise in distributed systems, cryptography, security, smart-contract engineering and protocol design. These skills can transfer across future blockchain architectures, Layer-2 systems, privacy technologies and tokenised applications.

blocks.label: Eligibility note
blocks.text: Web3 internships can require Solidity, JavaScript/TypeScript, Git, blockchain fundamentals, smart-contract testing and sometimes previous open-source contributions.

blocks.text: For Web3 development, smart-contract projects, security knowledge, GitHub contributions and deployed testnet applications are more valuable than collecting generic certificates.

Career progression

items: Junior Web3 Developer / Smart Contract Developer — 1–3 years
Senior Web3 Developer / Smart Contract Engineer — 6–10 years
Lead Blockchain Engineer / Protocol Engineer — 8–13 years
Web3 Engineering Lead / Protocol Engineering Lead — 15+ years

blocks.text: Progression depends heavily on the technology ecosystem, project quality and security expertise.
